description: Crawl a site from start_urls (same-domain links), extract per page; all items via browser::crawl::items.

attr.description: extract this attribute instead of text

html.description: extract inner HTML instead of text

all.description: return every match as a list

allowed_domains.description: only follow links on these hosts

download_delay.description: seconds to wait between crawl rounds

format.description: render page body to this format

css_selector.description: scope the render to this CSS subtree (e.g. a page's content div)

crawl_id.description: id for this crawl (default: random). Bind browser::crawl-item with this crawl_id before calling to receive items live; must not match a running crawl

stream_name.description: deprecated, ignored (adds a warning): items are no longer written to a stream; use browser::crawl::items or the browser::crawl-item trigger

items.description: a sample (at most 10) of the crawl's items; read all of them with browser::crawl::items

stream.description: deprecated echo kept for older callers: stream_name and the crawl id; nothing is written to a stream. Use crawl.id

id.description: pass to browser::crawl::items, or as the browser::crawl-item crawl_id filter

items_function.description: browser::crawl::items: paginated read of every retained item

retained.description: items readable with browser::crawl::items (less than stats.crawled when a retention cap was hit)

dropped_events.description: live events dropped because a slow consumer filled the bounded queue; read those items back

warnings.description: present when the request used deprecated input such as stream_name
